records.title: Expenditure for minorities welfare in Kerala
details: The projects under MsDP are need based. The States as per their need formulate and submit the projects under MsDP. Based on the approval of designated Committees, the Empowered Committee on MsDP in this Ministry approves the projects and accordingly funds are released to States. As such it is not possible to anticipate the amount which is going to be spent for Kerala in year 2016-17.

records.title: Kochi Metro Rail Project
details: It was inter alia stated that Government of Kerala submitted the proposal to the Ministry of Urban Development for setting up of Kochi Metro Rail in Kochi covering a total length of 25.3 km (fully elevated) from Alwaye to Petta at an estimated cost of Rs.2991.5 crore (excluding state taxes). The proposal for Kochi Metro Rail Project is under consideration of the Government presently.

records.title: new railway lines in Kerala
details: It was inter alia stated that an updating survey for construction of Nilambur Road–Nanjangud new line has been completed recently. As per the survey report, cost of construction of 238.40 kms long new line has been assessed as Rs. 1742.109 crore with Rate of Return of (-) 5.907%. In view of a number of major IT industrial houses setting up industries in the States of Kerala and Karnataka, travel needs of their employees have also been taken into consideration in this report for the proposed new line for Nilambur Road–Nanjangud. Further consideration of this proposal would be possible once the decision on the results of the survey are finalised.

records.title: Lokpal Bill
details: The National Common Minimum Programme of the Government envisages that the Lokpal Bill will be enacted into law. The Government has initiated action to bring forward the Lokpal Bill, 2004.

records.title: SLOW PROGRESS IN AI RESEARCH AND INNOVATION
details:
Under the IndiaAI FutureSkills pillar, the Government is developing an extensive AI talent and research pipeline by supporting 500 PhD fellows, 5,000 postgraduates and 8,000 undergraduates.
174 ITIs and Polytechnics across 27 States/UTs have been approved to set up additional IndiaAI Data and AI Labs.

records.title: CAPACITY AND UTILISATION OF STRATEGIC PETROLEUM RESERVES
details:
In July 2021, under Phase-II, Government also approved the establishment of two 
additional commercial-cum-strategic petroleum reserve facilities with total storage capacity of 6.5 
MMT in Chandikhol, Odisha (4 MMT) and Padur, Karnataka (2.5 MMT). For development of SPR 
facilities under Phase-II, a Public Private Partnership model is envisaged with a total estimated 
project cost of INR 14,527 crores.
